references.text: David speaks of the reward for the righteous, which can be seen as parallel to the promise of reward in Mark 10:30.
The author of Hebrews speaks of attaining a better life, which can be compared to the promise of eternal life in Mark 10:30.
Jesus gives a similar promise in Matthew, which corresponds with what he says in Mark 10:30.
Luke provides a parallel to Jesus' promise in Mark 10:30, regarding reward in this life and the next.
